_README: Produced from the Before steps of AUDIT_PROTOCOL.md. Every claim carries evidence; a section with an empty evidence string is OPEN regardless of how convincing it reads. Recon done 2026-09-13.

target.name: Longbow

source.route: robinhoodchain.blockscout.com /api/v2/smart-contracts/<addr> via real headless Chrome (~/.hermes/scripts/cfetch.sh) — curl is 403'd by Cloudflare from this datacenter IP
source.note: Base protocol + both curator vaults + 26 of 28 oracle feeds are fully source-readable. TWO of the 28 oracle feeds are Longbow's own and one is UNVERIFIED (CASHCAT adapter) — those cap at bytecode/black-box work.

contracts.role: SHARED quote feed for all 28 markets ("USDG / USD", 8dp)
CASHCAT market oracle feed, description "Uniswap V3 Pool Price in USD", 18dp, roundId 0
ORCL market oracle feed, verified name DualAggregator, 8dp, roundId 1956

target.coverage_gap: 28 per-market oracle instances enumerated and classified (26 Chainlink proxies + 2 custom). NOT yet read: the DualAggregator source, the CASHCAT adapter internals, the 26 per-asset Chainlink aggregators behind the proxies, Morpho Blue's owner contract (171B), the 28-callback lifecycle. The 25 collateral tokens are only identified by symbol/decimals — none audited as tokens (issuer trust, out of scope by default).

integrations.name: Morpho Blue
integrations.notes: 15582B verified v0.8.19; no upgrade path; feeRecipient 0x0

integrations.name: MorphoChainlinkOracleV2
integrations.notes: Morpho's own oracle code (GPL-2.0, v0.8.21), verified source read. price() validates answer>0 only — no updatedAt/staleness guard in the price path

integrations.name: Chainlink-interface equity feeds (26)
integrations.notes: 9,571B aggregator proxies, 8dp, phase-encoded roundIds ('RHNVDA / USD' etc.). Equity feeds FREEZE outside market hours: NVDA updatedAt measured 44.1h old while ETH feed was live

integrations.name: CASHCAT Uniswap V3 feed
integrations.notes: Longbow's own, UNVERIFIED. Bytecode has observe(uint32[]) (0x883bdbfd) and NOT slot0() ⇒ TWAP not spot. Window/depth unknown

integrations.name: DualAggregator (ORCL feed)
integrations.notes: RETRACTED as Longbow code: it is CHAINLINK's — a port of OCR2Aggregator (BUSL 1.1, imports @chainlink/contracts, typeAndVersion 'DualAggregator 1.0.0') with a secondary-report source + cutoffTime window. 23,186B is just a bigger Chainlink contract. So 27 of 28 feeds are Chainlink infra (26 proxies + this), and only the CASHCAT adapter is Longbow's own

integrations.name: feed ownership (all 27 Chainlink feeds)
integrations.notes: ONE address owns the DualAggregator and the aggregators behind the proxies (checked ETH/NVDA/SPCX): 0xeE27D5Ae494300902D90454e8630A3F1C68c9C52, a 171-byte contract (Safe-proxy shape). The whole collateral side is priced by feeds under a single owner

integrations.name: off-chain oracle watchdog + keeper
integrations.notes: Docs claim a watchdog compares each oracle to live DEX price and an armed keeper liquidates. Off-chain mitigation is not an on-chain guarantee

actors.name: Curator/owner (both vaults)
cannot: move vault funds outside Morpho markets it is enabled for
actors.verified_how: cast call on both vaults; cast codesize = 0

actors.name: Anyone (borrower)
can: supply collateral of any listed token
actors.verified_how: Morpho Blue is permissionless for supply/borrow/liquidate on existing markets

assumptions.statement: The 26 Chainlink-interface equity feeds report honestly and advance while their market is open
assumptions.breaks_if: an aggregator freezes/dies — nothing on-chain distinguishes frozen from fresh

assumptions.statement: Each tokenized-equity collateral is worth its oracle price per 18-dec unit
assumptions.breaks_if: a token is obtainable far below the oracle price, or represents a fraction of a share while priced as one ⇒ buy → post → borrow is direct theft of lender USDG

assumptions.statement: The CASHCAT Uniswap TWAP window is long enough to be manipulation-resistant on this chain's liquidity
assumptions.breaks_if: short window + thin pool ⇒ sustained push inflates collateral; bounded by Morpho market isolation (market 5 has ~$5 USDG, so impact should be near zero — verify the bound)

assumptions.statement: DualAggregator picks a source that is safe (not 'the higher' / not a stale fallback)
assumptions.breaks_if: source-selection logic can be steered or falls back without a freshness test

assumptions.statement: The single-EOA curator behaves honestly; the 1-day timelock bounds its power
assumptions.breaks_if: an instant (non-timelocked) power can reallocate the vault into a hostile market

invariants.statement: sum over markets of (suppliedAssets - borrowedAssets) == USDG balance held by Morpho Blue
invariants.result: Morpho holds 48,525.483821025 USDG ($48,525.48) — the entire lendable side

invariants.statement: For every market: borrowedUSD <= collateralUSD * LLTV
invariants.evidence: OPEN — my 6-field market() decode gave inconsistent share/asset ratios (supply pair 1e6, borrow pair 1.139e6, impossible for Morpho virtual shares); reconcile before quoting per-market debt

invariants.statement: For every market: the Morpho collateral balance * oracle price equals the tokens' real tradable value
invariants.check: compare oracle price vs on-chain DEX price per collateral token (Uniswap V3 USDG pools via factory.getPool + slot0 + liquidity)
invariants.result: PASS, FULL SWEEP — 26 of 28 collaterals compared (ORCL and COIN have no liquid V3 pool). EVERY one tracks its oracle within 0.90%, and every deviation is on the SAFE side (DEX at or ABOVE the oracle): WETH −0.17%, NVDA −0.06%, AMZN +0.33%, SLV +0.33%, GOOGL +0.04%, CASHCAT +0.21%, SPCX +0.13%, SPY +0.01%, QQQ +0.06%, GME +0.05%, USO +0.04%, MSFT −0.20%, SGOV −0.06%, USAR +0.13%, TSLA +0.06%, META +0.03%, AMD +0.21%, MU +0.24%, PLTR −0.11%, INTC +0.09%, SNDK +0.37%, TSM +0.90%, MSTR +0.69%, CRCL +0.36%, ASML +0.83%, BABA +0.14%. ZERO collaterals are obtainable below their oracle price ⇒ the buy→post→borrow theft path does NOT exist on this deployment
invariants.evidence: TARGETS/longbow/sweep_oracle_vs_dex.sh + sweep2 + /tmp/lb/sweep*.tsv; pools confirmed real (22,142B, liquidity>0) except the two flagged

invariants.statement: Oracle price is non-zero and non-stale enough to liquidate correctly
invariants.check: read Morpho's public source (done); fork test deferred
invariants.result: WITHDRAWN AS A FINDING — the missing staleness/bounds check is Morpho's DOCUMENTED design, not a Longbow defect: the source comments say 'Staleness is not checked because it's assumed that the Chainlink feed keeps its promises on this. The price is not checked to be in the min/max bounds because it's assumed that the Chainlink feed keeps its promises.' The live staleness itself is real (NVDA feed updatedAt 44.1h old while ETH's was current — equities are 24/5), but vanilla deployment of a documented upstream assumption is not reportable. Consequence worth recording for the trust model instead: the min/max guard Morpho declines to make is ALSO effectively absent here (every feed: minAnswer=1, maxAnswer≈9.58e52)
invariants.evidence: morpho-org/morpho-blue-oracles src/morpho-chainlink/libraries/ChainlinkDataFeedLib.sol; cast call minAnswer()/maxAnswer() on 0x4a9aBC75… and the aggregators behind 0x78F3556b…/0x379EC4f7…/0x42a95341…

invariants.statement: No single address can unilaterally change the price of the collateral backing the loan book
invariants.check: owner() on the DualAggregator and on the aggregators behind the proxies
invariants.result: FAILS BY CONCENTRATION — one owner address (0xeE27D5Ae…, 171-byte contract) sits above every feed checked. Inherited from Chainlink's deployment, not chosen by Longbow, but it means the entire collateral side depends on one owner being honest and operationally correct
invariants.evidence: cast call owner() on 0x4a9aBC75…, 0x6091E64e…(ETH agg), 0xC9d16E4f…(NVDA agg), 0x5eaa223c…(SPCX agg)

invariants.statement: All 28 oracles price in the same unit (1e36 * 10^(loanDec-collDec)) — no market can be over-borrowed purely from a scaling error
invariants.check: read SCALE_FACTOR + decode price() for each
invariants.result: PASS — SCALE_FACTOR 1e24 == 10**(36+6+8-18-8) for the stock markets; decoded prices sane (WETH 2503.0, NVDA 218.32, SPY 765.35, TSLA 365.95, SLV 58.10, SGOV 101.04)

invariants.statement: The vault cannot be made to hold a market's bad debt as a first-loss position
invariants.check: fork: create loss in one market, check other markets' suppliers unaffected

never_should_happen.statement: An outsider borrows more USDG than their collateral is really worth, and walks
never_should_happen.attempt: compared every big collateral's oracle price against its live Uniswap V3 USDG pool price (the precondition for buy→post→borrow)
never_should_happen.evidence: NVDA DEX $215.68 vs oracle $218.30; SPCX $149.38 vs $149.97; GOOGL $337.65 vs $339.05 — all at or BELOW the oracle, so collateral cannot be obtained cheaply. Coverage: 3 of 25 tokens

never_should_happen.statement: A market prices its collateral off a frozen feed while the real asset has moved
never_should_happen.attempt: to run: anvil fork, freeze the aggregator (impersonate), move the real asset, borrow at the stale price
never_should_happen.evidence: staleness measured on live feeds (INV-4); exploitability not yet shown — needs a fork

never_should_happen.statement: A liquidation is executed at a manipulable or stale price that a third party can steer
never_should_happen.attempt: to run: identify the liquidation trigger price source and try to front-run it

never_should_happen.statement: The single-EOA curator moves vault funds into a hostile/malicious market
never_should_happen.attempt: enumerate instant vault powers (setIsAllocator/setCurator/setFee/setSupplyQueue) vs timelocked ones, then attempt on a fork
never_should_happen.evidence: vault holds $8.02 today ⇒ low severity, but the mechanism is reusable

sections.name: Base protocol + vaults identified (Morpho Blue, 2x MetaMorphoV1_1, roles)
sections.evidence: verified source fetched for all four; owner/curator/guardian/fee/timelock reads; vault totalAssets 8.02 USDG and 0; supplyQueueLength=28

sections.name: Market enumeration (28 markets, collaterals, LLTV, per-market oracle)
sections.evidence: /tmp/lb/markets.txt: 28 supplyQueue entries → idToMarketParams for loan/collateral/oracle/irm/lltv; all loanToken=USDG, single IRM

sections.name: Oracle layer classification (which feeds are custom vs Chainlink)
sections.evidence: codesize sweep: 26 feeds at 9,571B (Chainlink proxies), CASHCAT 5,207B (custom, unverified), ORCL 23,186B (DualAggregator, verified)

sections.name: Oracle arithmetic correctness (decimals / scale factor / decoded prices)
sections.evidence: INV-5 PASS — SCALE_FACTOR 1e24 consistent with 6dp USDG / 18dp collateral / 8dp feeds; decoded prices match reality

sections.name: ORCL feed source review
sections.evidence: CLOSED AS UPSTREAM: DualAggregator is Chainlink's OCR2Aggregator port (BUSL 1.1, imports @chainlink/contracts) with a secondary-report source and s_cutoffTime window validity (lines 541/562/572); owner + min/max are Chainlink's. Not Longbow's code ⇒ auditing it is upstream work, not reportable here. RETRACTION recorded: I had flagged the 23,186B size as 'Longbow's own'.

sections.name: CASHCAT Uniswap adapter (unverified — reverse-engineer: TWAP window, pool, immutables, manipulation cost)
sections.evidence: Confirmed TWAP via observe(uint32[]) present / slot0() absent. Both CASHCAT/USDG V3 pools (fee 500 0xf3a57982…, fee 3000 0x525dD86C…) show liquidity=0, and neither matches the adapter's $0.16459 (slot0-implied $0.1175 / $0.2549) ⇒ which pool it reads is still unknown. Impact capped by market isolation (~$5 USDG in market 5).

sections.name: Staleness/liveness on a 24/5 equity feed
sections.evidence: CLOSED NEGATIVE — WITHDRAWN AS A FINDING. Source read from morpho-org/morpho-blue-oracles proves the absence of a staleness/bounds check is deliberate and documented by Morpho ('assumed that the Chainlink feed keeps its promises'). Vanilla use of an upstream documented assumption is not a Longbow defect.

sections.name: Collateral valuation vs real tradable price
sections.evidence: CLOSED NEGATIVE for the three biggest collateral lines (NVDA −1.2%, SPCX −0.4%, GOOGL −0.4% vs their real Uniswap V3 USDG pools) ⇒ no buy→post→borrow theft path. Coverage caveat: 3 of 25 tokens tested; the memecoin (CASHCAT) is handled in S6.

sections.name: Curator powers / instant vs timelocked paths
Liquidation path end-to-end (who triggers, at what price, who receives collateral)
value_flows: liquidate() collateral swap → bad debt to that market's suppliers

guards: maxWithdraw limited by available liquidity in allocated markets
value_movers.notes: Not a theft path — but 'idle = 0' exits can freeze redeems when markets are fully utilised

guards: market must be in supplyQueue and enabled
value_movers.notes: The single most powerful instant action a curator has; S9 tests whether cap bounds are airtight

guards: withdraw limited by market liquidity and by HEALTH check for collateralised positions
value_movers.notes: Trustless; the only place lender USDG leaves is here

value_movers.bounded_by: LLTV x oracle price x collateral
value_movers.notes: ★ THIS is the outsider lever: it is bounded by the ORACLE, so every oracle defect is a borrow defect

guards: position must be unhealthy per oracle price
bad-debt socialisation to that market's suppliers only
value_movers.notes: If the oracle under-reports, honest positions get liquidated; if it over-reports, bad debt lands on suppliers

guards: answer > 0 only (no staleness/round validation in the V2 price path)
value_movers.notes: ★ Single most load-bearing read in the system — 28 markets, all borrowing/liquidation bound by it

guards: onlyOwner; timelock applies to caps/guardian/removal, need to confirm for each

main_functions.why_everything_depends_on_it: the only path by which an outsider extracts lender USDG; bounded entirely by the oracle
every borrow, withdraw-health check and liquidation resolves through it
converts a mispriced oracle into realised bad debt for that market's suppliers
moves the vault's liquidity between markets; caps are its only bound

passes.scope: enumerate contracts, roles, markets, oracles, money
hypotheses: team's 'only oracle adapters are ours' claim holds
passes.result: CONFIRMED, and narrower than first reported: 27 of 28 feeds are Chainlink infrastructure; exactly ONE feed is Longbow's own (the UNVERIFIED CASHCAT Uniswap adapter). An earlier version of this pass said '2 of 28' — retracted in pass 5
NEGATIVE — SCALE_FACTOR 1e24 correct for 6dp/18dp/8dp; decoded prices sane for 6 markets

passes.scope: staleness of 24/5 equity feeds vs on-chain liquidation
hypotheses: no updatedAt guard ⇒ frozen feed indistinguishable from live
passes.result: HYPOTHESIS WITHDRAWN on reading the source — the missing check is Morpho's documented upstream design ('assumed that the Chainlink feed keeps its promises'), so vanilla deployment is not a Longbow finding. Live staleness confirmed as a condition (NVDA 44.1h stale) but not reportable

passes.scope: is any collateral obtainable below its oracle price, and does anything bound a bad report?
hypotheses: min/max circuit breaker protects against a bad report
passes.result: H3 NEGATIVE for the 3 biggest lines (NVDA −1.2%, SPCX −0.4%, GOOGL −0.4% vs live USDG pools). NEW TRUST FACTS: every feed has one owner (0xeE27D5Ae…, 171B contract) and effectively no circuit breaker (minAnswer=1, maxAnswer≈9.58e52), so the guard Morpho delegates to Chainlink is absent in practice
passes.evidence: Uniswap V3 factory getPool + slot0 math; owner()/minAnswer()/maxAnswer()

passes.scope: re-check every promoted claim against primary data
passes.result: BOTH RETRACTED — DualAggregator is Chainlink's OCR2 port; the 500 was intermittent for verified and unverified alike. Recorded rather than quietly dropped

open_questions: S6: which pool does the CASHCAT adapter read, what TWAP window, and can the empty-liquidity pools be initialized/steered? (impact capped at ~$5 by isolation)
S9: which vault powers are instant vs timelocked, and is the per-market cap bound airtight?
S10: liquidation path end-to-end — who triggers, what price, and can a third party displace/steer it?
INV-2: reconcile the market() field decode before quoting per-market debt
Coverage: only 3 of 25 collateral tokens compared against real market prices
MANDATORY before any clean verdict: fork-attack phase has NOT run (impersonate/forge a feed report, try to borrow past LLTV, try to displace a liquidation)
